svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Mint Price logo, v6
svg.desc: The selected soft-rounded local price tag in mint green, with a compact, cohesive dollar-zero lockup. The entire mark and any internal typography share one minus-eight-degree rotation. Right and bottom points and openings remain identical reflected motifs. Paired with the exact Free-Stuff-Near-You name in deep green. Original, unadopted concept with editable text and transparent surroundings.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif
